en.text: Acacia cowleana, commonly known as Halls Creek wattle, and other names in Australian Aboriginal languages, is a species of flowering plant in the family Fabaceae and is endemic to northern Australia. It is an erect, openly branched, sometimes spindly shrub or tree with leathery, more or less sickle-shaped phyllodes, spikes of bright golden yellow flowers and linear, papery to leathery pods.
